map.加权总分 = Σ(已出成绩ᵢ × 权重ᵢ ÷ 100)（仅统计成绩非空且为数的项: Weighted total = Σ(graded itemᵢ × weightᵢ ÷ 100) (counting only items whose score is non-empty and numeric); graded weight = sum of the weights of those items; remaining weight = total weight − graded weight. Validation: target score defaults to 60; items with an empty score are excluded. Criteria: required score on the remaining items = (target score − weighted total) ÷ (remaining weight÷100); ≤0 is rated "already achieved", >100 "impossible to achieve", and otherwise shown with one decimal.
map.最终加权平均分 = 加权总分 ÷ (总权重 ÷ 100)（按百制权重归一），仅在: Final weighted average = weighted total ÷ (total weight ÷ 100) (normalized on the 100-point weight basis), given only when all items are graded and the total weight >0, otherwise "some scores not yet available" is shown. Validation: target score defaults to 60. Criteria: output together with total weight/graded weight/remaining weight/required remaining score in the same table.
